changes: All eight authored bosses use one living-player selector scoped to the same campaign zone and area; invalid coordinates and defeated/downed players are excluded.
Dormant bosses can activate when a living guest reaches them first. Brute, Marksman and Fallen failed this check before the fix.

Hydra attack strength now uses the existing regional/difficulty boss curve, independently of the ordinary restraint entities. Restraint HP, warnings, exposure windows and release story are unchanged. Co-op scales health, not this attack damage.

naturalFirstHits.entry: staged arena, levels 5 + 3 per zone, legal common/uncommon/rare gear

weaponReach.method: one real basic attack against an active boss; special exposure windows staged

targeting.method: actual game update with complete peer records, spy records the target passed to each encounter

guestArrival.method: actual game update, host outside wake range, valid or ineligible peer nearby

deathRetry.method: lethal QA hit, actual death screen and retry button

completion.method: staged lethal events test blocked exits, remaining guards, single rewards, Hydra mercy, Marble orb and final King sequence; not complete combat wins

coOp.transport: Production host/guest handlers over a local serialized relay, with normal position interpolation and matching run identity.

verification.saveCompatibility: A genuine previous-release Storm Coast checkpoint retains level 20, XP 38, Ranger rank 7 / XP 100, 12077 gold, rare bow, completed hub request and correct boss arena.
verification.pureRegression: 146 target cases, damage scaling, preserved soldier/trial formula, Hydra state replication; all eight existing encounter suites pass.
verification.visual: Normal-camera Brute approach/charge and Hydra warning/hit/recovery observed; screenshots and real-time samples saved. Not an all-camera/all-device certification.
verification.syntax: Both inline game scripts, hydra.js and local fixture parse; diff whitespace check passes.

testSetupCorrections: Early ranged checks fired before dormant bosses activated. Waiting for natural activation yielded 24/24 passes before production edits; no artificial projectile correction was made.
Initial peer stubs omitted interpolation fields; corrected to use MP.mkPeer. Local relay setup uses MP.onEnter and stable enemy IDs for the officer trio.
A staging-only stale death overlay was removed in the fresh-scene helper, matching the real death-screen retry/return flow.
limits: No full fresh-character campaign playthrough in this pass.
No public-network WebRTC or laptop/GPU performance verdict.
Trials, side-mode difficulty, storyline, camera algorithms and level geometry are unchanged.
next: Check ordinary campaign combat, fresh-save progression and first-time player pacing. Keep hardware/network playtesting distinct from automated logic checks.
